_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Critical Safety Item Inspection and Material Certification Report
summary: Specifies the format and content for the Critical Safety Item Inspection and Material Certification Report, which documents Objective Quality Evidence of inspection and certification for critical safety items.
use_relationship:
The Critical Safety Item Inspection and Material Certification Report provides a complete document set of Objective Quality Evidence (OQE) of inspection and certification.  These sheets are required for all Critical Safety Items.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract SOW.

This DID supersedes DI-SAFT-81933.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

children.title: Title of CDRL and CDRL number.
The body of the report shall contain the following:
Completed Process/Operations Sheets (when needed by the contractor to document necessary OQE).

The recorded results (actual readings and/or measurements) of Quality Conformance and Lot Sampling Inspection for all associated attributes and characteristics that are present in the requirement/drawings and specifications.
OQE of Government witness of GSI hold points.
Flight Safe certification number/MIC number (when MIC marking is required on the part(s)).
May include any other additional OQE (as required to demonstrate that the part(s) conform to the requirements/specifications).
